preconditions.description: The length of the input string str must be between 1 and 30.
The number of allowed swaps K must be between 1 and 10.
The input string str must contain only digit characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the largest number possible formed by performing at most K swaps on the digits of str.
The length of the output string must be equal to the length of the input string.
The output string must be lexicographically greater than or equal to the input string.
